question: Find Hodgkin Lymphoma trials with median follow‑up and show months by arm.

gemini.answer: This query retrieves Hodgkin Lymphoma trials and displays the clinical trial identifier (NCT), authors, year, pubmed ID, median follow-up duration overall, in the treatment arm, and in the control arm.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\", \"follow_up_duration_rx_months\", \"follow_up_duration_control_months\" FROM public.\"clinical_trials\" WHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%Hodgkin%'",
  "answer": "This query retrieves Hodgkin Lymphoma trials and displays the clinical trial identifier (NCT), authors, year, pubmed ID, median follow-up duration overall, in the treatment arm, and in the control arm.",

}
```
